excerpt.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

scope.zh: 提亚奇首次接触的两个阶段：第一阶段「怪异热源」（10）与第二阶段「提亚奇」（15），含选项、结束首次接触及与原始呼唤起源的衔接。
scope.en: Both stages of the Tiyanki first contact: stage 1 "Weird Heat Blobs" (10) and stage 2 "Tiyanki" (15), with options, the end of first contact and the Primal Calling hook.

texts.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
texts.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附近恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the nearby star system appears here.

texts.zh:
我们称之为“缇扬奇”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
texts.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which we call "Tiyanki" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is highly unlikely, to say the least, that this is their only food source, but intake of other nutrients has yet to be observed.

They will not attack unless provoked. They can safely be ignored.

texts.zh:
圣者们将那个漂浮在黑暗中的存在称为“缇扬奇”。他们是神圣而酷爱和平的太空生命体，从一个恒星系漫步到另一个恒星系，依靠众多气态巨行星上表面的常见气体进食，几乎不会有任何表现敌意的情况。

我们应该与其保持距离，以示敬意。
texts.en:
The Diviners name the beings, floating through the dark, "Tiyanki." They are a sacred and peaceful spaceborne life form that roams from system to system, feeding on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, and rarely showing any signs of hostility.

We are to keep at a respectful distance.

texts.zh:
[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的社会学研究领袖称之为缇扬奇”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
texts.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which the [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Head of Society Research has come to refer to as "Tiyanki" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is highly unlikely, to say the least, that this is their only food source, but intake of other nutrients has yet to be observed.

They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked. They can safely be ignored.

texts.zh: 值得注意的是，每个缇扬奇群体都以母系等级制度为中心，由一头雌兽领导。雌性优先享用所有食物资源，以便为幼崽生产气态母体物质，并引导群体迁徙。因此，雄兽在资源匮乏时会放弃进食，鼓励它们在群体休息时寻找更多食物。
texts.en: Of note, there is a matriarchal hierarchy at the center of each Tiyanki pod, with a singular cow leading the group at any one time. Females are given priority to all food resources, allowing them to produce maternal gases for their young and direct the pod's migrations. As such, bulls will forgo nourishment whenever resources are scarce, encouraging them to scout for more food while the pod rests.

label.zh: 捕猎他们也捞不到什么好处。
label.en: Hunting them would be a net loss anyway.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的形容词。
note.en: In the game, your empire's adjective appears here.

notes.zh: 审阅注：这是提亚奇（太空鲸）首次接触的第二阶段 tiyanki_stage_2（难度3）事件；第一阶段是 first_contact_critters.10（故事 event-first-contact-critters-10），其唯一选项进入本阶段。本事件结束首次接触（finish_first_contact_effect），并向所有者隐藏发出 grand_archive.200（原始呼唤起源在此接入）。
notes.en: Review note: this is stage 2 (tiyanki_stage_2, difficulty 3) of the Tiyanki first contact; stage 1 is first_contact_critters.10 (story event-first-contact-critters-10), whose single option enters this stage. The event ends first contact (finish_first_contact_effect) and fires the hidden grand_archive.200 to the owner, where the Primal Calling origin hooks in.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项按本方类型互斥出现——唯灵、唯物或格式塔（无探索协议）、机械探索协议、其余；全部都给“太空鲸武器”科技选项/进度（已有选项则进度更多），其余类型中排外、军国或杀戮帝国额外增加猎杀数。
notes.en: Review note: the options are mutually exclusive by empire type: spiritualist, materialist or gestalt (without the exploration protocol), machine exploration protocol, and everyone else. All grant the space-whale weapon tech option/progress (more if the option was already open); in the last group xenophobes, militarists and homicidal empires also raise the hunted-fauna count.

summary.text:
# 怪异热源 / Weird Heat Blobs
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（提亚奇 tiyanki_stage_1 → tiyanki_stage_2）
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_NPC_country_types_events.txt:114–338` · `common/first_contact/01_first_contact_space_fauna_and_NPCs.txt:45–83` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:89–656`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society 第一阶段；r2-society 第二阶段；协调合并 coordinator merge）

## 如何开始 How it starts

与提亚奇（tiyanki / tiyanki_garrison）类国家首次相遇时，setup_first_contact_path 启动 tiyanki_stage_1（难度3）。/ Meeting a Tiyanki-type country starts tiyanki_stage_1 (difficulty 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **怪异热源（10）**：远程扫描发现巨大“热团”，值得调查；唯一选项 A 设为第二阶段 tiyanki_stage_2（难度3，第134行）。/ Weird heat blobs; the only option sets stage 2 (line 134).
2. **提亚奇（15）**：第二阶段的阶段事件（`01_first_contact_space_fauna_and_NPCs.txt:77`）。正文随本方类型有格式塔、唯灵、其余三版，“原始呼唤”起源追加一段。/ Stage 2's event; gestalt, spiritualist and default texts, plus an extra Primal Calling passage.
3. 之后（after）：`finish_first_contact_effect` 结束首次接触，并隐藏触发 `grand_archive.200`（原始呼唤起源在此接入）。/ First contact ends and the hidden `grand_archive.200` fires (where the Primal Calling origin hooks in).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

线性两阶段；15 的选项按本方类型互斥出现（唯灵 / 唯物或无机械探索协议的格式塔 / 机械探索协议 / 其余），全部给予“太空鲸武器”科技选项或进度，并都结束首次接触。/ Two linear stages; 15's options are exclusive by empire type and all grant the space-whale weapon tech option or progress, then end first contact.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

唯灵进度 0.2/0.6，其余 0.1/0.3（视是否已有该科技选项）；“其余”一组中排外、军国或杀戮帝国另增猎杀数，`is_homicidal` 改变措辞。/ Spiritualists get 0.2/0.6 progress, others 0.1/0.3; in the default group xenophobes, militarists and homicidal empires also raise the hunted-fauna count.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：事件 10 与 15、两个阶段定义、15 的四类选项、共享的 finish_first_contact_effect。/ Events 10 and 15, both stage definitions, 15's option groups, the shared finish effect.
- 更正 Corrections：编译器从共享的 finish_first_contact_effect 画出的九个外链（商队、掠夺者、纳玛里安、first_contact.11xx、galactic_features.387）不是本故事的后续，已移除。/ Nine external links drawn from the shared finish effect were suppressed.
- 合并 Merge（2026-10-13）：15 原为单独故事 event-first-contact-critters-15，现作为第二阶段并入；旧注释“15 属于原始呼唤篇”已过时（grand_archive.200 已作为共享节点处理）。/ 15 was a separate story and is now stage 2 here; the old note placing it in the Primal Calling story was stale.
